record.question: Which of the following are components of Central Processing Unit(CPU)?
options: Arithmetic logic unit and control unit
Arithmetic logic unit and integrated circuits
record.explanation: The conventional CPU block diagram includes the ALU and control unit; mouse and monitor are peripherals, not CPU components. Evidence: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/docs/processors/what-is-a-cpu.html Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
